sources_used: Ahold Delhaize FY20-FY24 Annual Reports + Q1-Q3 2025 results (https://www.aholddelhaize.com/investors)
_ordering_rationale: Ahold Delhaize grocery global : Net Consumer Sales (KPI #1), US Sales (60% groupe), EU Sales, Online Sales (e-commerce), comp sales, OpMargin.

kpis.signal: CA stabilisé, focus mix online + private label + Save for Our Customers (efficiency)
kpis.description_fr: CA net consommateurs groupe Ahold Delhaize (US + EU). Inclut Stop & Shop, Food Lion, Albert Heijn, Delhaize, etc.
kpis.description_en: Ahold Delhaize group net consumer sales (US + EU). Includes Stop & Shop, Food Lion, Albert Heijn, Delhaize, etc.

kpis.signal: ~60% CA groupe, mix bandes Food Lion + Hannaford + Stop & Shop. Comp sales US +0.6% FY24.
kpis.description_fr: CA net USA Ahold Delhaize (Food Lion + Hannaford + Stop & Shop + Giant + The GIANT Company). ~60% CA groupe, segment majoritaire.
kpis.description_en: Ahold Delhaize US net sales (Food Lion + Hannaford + Stop & Shop + Giant + The GIANT Company). ~60% group revenue, majority segment.

kpis.signal: Pays-Bas (Albert Heijn) + Belgique + Europe centrale (Delhaize Serbie + Roumanie + Tchéquie + Grèce)
kpis.description_fr: CA net Europe Ahold Delhaize (Albert Heijn NL + Delhaize BE + Albert CZ + Mega Image RO + Alfa Beta GR + Maxi RS). Albert Heijn = joyau marge.
kpis.description_en: Ahold Delhaize Europe net sales (Albert Heijn NL + Delhaize BE + Albert CZ + Mega Image RO + Alfa Beta GR + Maxi RS). Albert Heijn = margin jewel.

kpis.signal: Online ~11% CA groupe, leader e-grocery Pays-Bas (bol.com cédé fin 2024), Peapod US
kpis.description_fr: CA e-commerce groupe (epicerie en ligne + bol.com pré-cession + Peapod + click-and-collect). bol.com cédé fin 2024.
kpis.description_en: Group e-commerce sales (online grocery + bol.com pre-divestiture + Peapod + click-and-collect). bol.com divested end-2024.

kpis.signal: Normalisation post-inflation, focus volumes + traffic en 2025
kpis.description_fr: Croissance comparable groupe ex-fuel (à magasins comparables, hors carburant). Mesure organique trafic + ticket.
kpis.description_en: Group comparable sales growth ex-fuel (same-store, ex-fuel). Organic measure of traffic + ticket.

kpis.signal: Marge stable 4%, supérieure aux pairs grocery (Tesco ~4.2%, Carrefour ~3.0%)
kpis.description_fr: Marge opérationnelle sous-jacente groupe. Stable 4%, leadership grocery EU/US. Cible maintien >4% via private label + Save for Our Customers.
kpis.description_en: Group underlying operating margin. Stable 4%, grocery leader EU/US. Target >4% via private label + Save for Our Customers.

_notes: Ahold Delhaize FY = calendaire. Sources : Annual Reports FY20-FY24 + Q1-Q3 2025 results.
